key_findings: Biggest gap between views: Paid Social has 16.2% of first-touch credit against 4.9% of last-non-direct credit (437 against 133 sign-ups).

Most undervalued by last click: Paid Social, mostly TikTok (342 of its 437 first-touch sign-ups). Opener index 3.29, assist ratio 2.38 (strong feeder): 317 of its 437 first-touch sign-ups closed through another channel, 150 of them through Paid Search.

Main risk: Google Ads, LinkedIn and TikTok claim 1,426 sign-ups, 1.59 times GA4's blended credit for Paid Search and Paid Social (898). TikTok's claim ratio is 2.79 because 350 of its 540 are view-through, and brand search closes what TikTok opens, so both count the same people.

brand.read: a closer by nature: judged on what it costs to defend, not on its CPA

undervalued_by_last_click.why: it finds 437 sign-ups but closes 133; cut it on last-click CPA and the 317 it hands to other channels go too

near_misses: Referral opens (index 1.56) but hands fewer sign-ups to other channels than it closes itself (assist ratio 0.76, under 1.0), so it misses the undervalued rule

over_credited_by_last_click.why: it closes 735 sign-ups but found only 495; 355 came from other channels; the Brand campaign holds 410 of its 735 sign-ups
it closes 327 sign-ups but found only 27; 307 came from other channels

possible_cannibalisation.overlap: about 528 sign-ups claimed beyond GA4's blended credit; the biggest shared journey is found via Paid Social, came back via Paid Search (150)

budget.source_why: blended CPA $161.75, 113% above the paid average, and not an opener (index 1.08)
budget.receiver_why: undervalued by last click (opener index 7.6) with a blended CPA of $63.57, within the average
budget.test: move $920: 20% of LinkedIn Ads' four-week spend ($4,604) to TikTok Ads, for one four-week test
budget.projection_note: $920 / $63.57; an upper bound: extra spend rarely buys at the average CPA
budget.confidence_why: TikTok Ads has 193.5 blended sign-ups in the window (100 or more is high)
risks: LinkedIn Ads may bring bigger accounts: sign_up has no value, so plan size can't be seen. Send the chosen plan's price as the sign_up value to check before moving more.
TikTok Ads' audience can run out: no call here reads its reach or frequency.
LinkedIn Ads' own hand-offs aren't visible: GA4's matrix is by channel, and Paid Social mixes LinkedIn and TikTok.

tests_to_run.test: Capped shift from LinkedIn Ads to TikTok Ads
tests_to_run.how: move $920 over four weeks, keep everything else fixed, and compare blended CPA and Paid Search brand sign-ups with the four weeks before

pause the Brand campaign on alternate weeks where organic brand position is 1, and watch whether total brand sign-ups fall or move to organic
